editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CNCF GitOps and ArgoCD Certification. Master GitOps terminology, principles, related practices, patterns, and tooling across 5 distinct domains.
editorial.overview: The CNCF GitOps and ArgoCD Certification, administered by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, evaluates your technical knowledge across exactly 5 distinct domains during a standard 90-minute examination. This evaluation covers GitOps terminology, principles, related practices, patterns, and tooling to validate your operational competency in declarative continuous deployment workflows across cloud-native environments.
editorial.who_should_take: Platform engineers, DevOps specialists, and Kubernetes administrators with practical experience implementing GitOps workflows using Argo CD will benefit from taking this exam to validate their deployment automation skills.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To successfully prepare for this technical examination lasting 90 minutes, candidates should review core GitOps concepts, terminology, and baseline principles. Practice configuring automated sync policies, application sets, sync options, and resource handling within Argo CD environments to master the practical operational aspects required for the certification.

domain_guidance.summary: Master the core terminology associated directly with GitOps, Argo CD, and Kubernetes declarative continuous deployment workflows to establish a strong understanding of cloud-native delivery structures during your preparation across the 5 domains.
study_focus: Understand Argo CD components and CRDs
Learn synchronization states and application phases

domain_guidance.summary: Understand the fundamental principles governing modern GitOps, including declarative system descriptions, version-controlled desired state definitions, and automated synchronization mechanisms that ensure target environments match configurations precisely during the 90 minute evaluation period.
study_focus: Study automated sync policies and self-healing
Learn Git repository tracking and push-based deployments

domain_guidance.summary: Explore operational practices related to GitOps workflows, including continuous integration pipelines, secure secret management, and cluster bootstrapping strategies required for reliable and secure production application deployments across your chosen architecture.
study_focus: Integrate CI pipelines with Git push actions
Manage resource deletions and safety mechanisms

domain_guidance.summary: Examine deployment patterns, progressive delivery strategies, sync waves, and application pruning configurations designed to handle complex multi-environment architectures and ensure smooth application rollouts across target clusters during the certification.
study_focus: Configure sync options like prune and allow-empty
Manage application sets and out-of-sync resources

domain_guidance.summary: Learn the specific tooling used throughout the GitOps ecosystem, focusing heavily on Argo CD CLI commands, custom manifests, and server configurations needed to manage continuous delivery pipelines effectively throughout the 5 domains.
study_focus: Use the argocd app set command for configurations
Configure sync options and annotations on resources

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully during the 90-minute duration. Read each question carefully, noting specific sync options, configuration parameters, and Argo CD behaviors before selecting your final answers.

faq.answer_text: The CNCF GitOps and ArgoCD Certification exam has a duration of 90 minutes. Candidates should pace themselves across all 5 domains to complete the questions efficiently within this strict timeframe.

This certification is offered and officially certified by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, establishing recognized industry standards for cloud-native operational competencies across modern development teams.

faq.question_title: How many domains are covered on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The formal examination covers exactly 5 distinct domains to test your knowledge comprehensively. These specific areas include GitOps Terminology, GitOps Principles, Related Practices, GitOps Patterns, and Tooling.

faq.question_title: What should I do for long-term certification planning?
faq.answer_text: For long-term certification paths, continuing education credits, and future updates regarding the CNCF GitOps and ArgoCD Certification, check with CNCF for the most current guidelines and requirements.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official CNCF source documentation, exam guides, and verified curriculum facts to provide accurate guidance for the certification process.
